changelog:
Initial release of huawei-cloud-find-skills skill.

- Enables users to search, discover, browse, and install Huawei Cloud agent skills by keyword or category.
- Provides functionality to view detailed documentation for each skill.
- Guides users through the installation process via supported commands, including usage of GitCode and GitHub repositories.
- Requires Python 3.6+ and network access to designated APIs for operation.
- Includes bilingual (Chinese & English) keyword mapping and flexible, score-based search heuristics for improved skill matching.
